review_scope: Full 14-definition artifact and full linked local scanner, read as data; neither executed. Outbound platform documentation not certified.

claims.statement: Protect the default and production branches with a reviewed combination of change review and integration checks.
claims.decision: GHQR critical recommendation; default-branch scanner scope is narrower than production-branch prose.

claims.statement: Require at least one independent approval when the selected review policy requires peer review.
claims.decision: GHQR critical recommendation; solo-maintainer operation needs an explicit compensating workflow, not fabricated approval.

claims.statement: Consider a higher review quorum for high-risk production changes.
claims.decision: GHQR advisory threshold of two is contextual, not universally mandatory.

claims.statement: Invalidate stale approvals when subsequent commits change the reviewed proposal.
Require designated owners to review changes to their owned paths.
claims.decision: Binding gap: CODEOWNERS existence and conversation resolution do not verify required owner review.

claims.statement: Specify an integrated review policy covering quorum, stale approval handling and ownership review.
claims.decision: Composite recommendation; must preserve all component obligations, not map only to PR existence.

claims.statement: Require integration checks against an up-to-date base when strict status-check policy applies.
claims.decision: Binding gap: general integration-revision review is not deterministic enforcement of strict mode.

claims.statement: Name the specific required build, test or other integration checks.
claims.decision: Required-check policy must have nonempty contexts and trusted publishers.

claims.statement: Require configured integration checks to succeed before integration.
claims.decision: Presence of a workflow is insufficient.

claims.statement: Reject non-fast-forward updates on protected branches.
claims.decision: Explicitly review bypass principals and approved recovery.
Cleanup conventions for topic branches are separate scope.

claims.statement: Evaluate required commit signatures as an integrity mechanism with explicit trust assumptions.
claims.decision: Conflict: source asserts author authenticity too strongly; key/account attribution is not universal proof of human authorship.

claims.statement: Consider a linear integration history where delivery and audit requirements justify it.
claims.decision: Contextual option; preserve tmcw opposition to universal squash/rebase policy.

claims.statement: Recognize ruleset-based protection without requiring a redundant legacy protection rule.
claims.decision: Source informational finding is not proof of effective protection, bypass coverage or tested rejection.

observations.statement: Missing legacy protection detail emits repo-bp-001 and returns; this function does not itself perform the fallback described in its comment.
Ruleset evaluator separately emits repo-bp-014 and evaluates supplied flags. Caller composition and effective-rule collection remain to be audited.
Review count, stale review, owner review, strict checks, nonempty contexts, force pushes, deletion, signing and linear history use supplied values, not native behavior tests.

limits: Absent observations and effective bypass access cannot be inferred from booleans alone.
Commented fallback is not proof of call-site handling.
Upstream two-review threshold and history preference are not adopted universal requirements.
